purpose: Implement the first customer-useful CORE-02 slice: Song-bound Session objective, scratch exploration, explicit promotion, debrief and next action so rough work survives restart without silently becoming Artist doctrine.

lineage.outcome: The artist can begin a real Song work session with an objective, preserve rough/rejected/unresolved thinking without hardening it into taste doctrine, explicitly promote only chosen learning, close with a debrief/next action and resume that state after restart.
lineage.capability: Song Session objective, scratch memory, explicit promotion, debrief and next action

legacy_candidates: session objective/debrief semantics as behavioral evidence only

completion_proof: a Song/version-bound Session starts with an explicit objective and only one open Session exists per Song
OBSERVATION/DECISION/REJECTED_IDEA/UNRESOLVED/MARK scratch survives restart but creates no EvidenceClaim by itself
explicit promotion creates exactly one matching EvidenceClaim and immutable Session provenance link; retry is idempotent
a failed EvidenceClaim write may leave a harmless retryable promotion request but no durable doctrine claim
Session/version/promotion scope cannot cross Songs or profiles
closing requires a debrief plus next action, is one-way, and later scratch cannot rewrite the closed Session
Session rows, scratch, promotion requests and promotion links are immutable history
Session started/scratch/promoted/closed events appear in canonical Activity chronology
reopen restores latest Session, scratch, promoted evidence, debrief and next action
Session read APIs perform zero canonical writes after initialization
non_scope: Artist World taste promotion policy beyond explicit Session promotion
next_selection_rule: After CORE-02A evidence, reconcile and globally compare the remaining CORE-02 learning/session gaps against the still dependency-ready CORE-03 capability resolver. Do not continue Session storage by adjacency.
